title: Daily Lunch Menus
description: Archived Tokyo 2015 OpenStack Summit lunch menus and location map, including daily menu images and a PDF download.
body:
Check video monitors for real time updates about lunch availability.

Kosher and Halal meals will be available in Hokushin, Bldg. #3, 3F. Please ask a server for more information. Gluten Free and Vegetarian options will be available in Marmolada, Bldg. #1, B1F and Il Leone, Bldg. #1, B3F.

Please join us for a sweet treat in the Marketplace after lunch.

Use the following map to find lunch locations across the Tokyo Summit Campus. Click the map to view a larger version or save the image to your device.

Click on a menu to enlarge it or

Download the daily menus
